fields.value: RARE: A Labeled Dataset for Cloud-Native Memory Anomalies

dsDescriptionValue.value: The dataset is linked to the paper RARE: A Labeled Dataset for Cloud-Native Memory Anomalies (https://doi.org/10.1145/3416505.3423560) This dataset has been generated using a microservice for injecting artificial byte stream in order to overload the nodes, provoking memory anomalies, It includes 2 files: - List_of_anomalies.csv includes the details on the anomalies injected - RARE.csv is the actual dataset. There are a total of 30 anomalies injected in the dataset. The full dataset comprise 10K labelled time-series, each with 7062 metrics.
